name: Why does my room smell moldy, even if I don't see mold?

mainEntity.name: Why does my room smell moldy, even if I don't see mold?

acceptedAnswer.text: A moldy smell often indicates the presence of mold growth, even if it's not visible. Mold can grow behind walls, under flooring, in attics, or in crawl spaces where moisture is present. The smell comes from volatile organic compounds (VOCs) produced by mold as it grows. High humidity, a recent water leak, or poor ventilation can create ideal conditions for hidden mold. It's important to address the source of moisture and have a professional inspection to identify and remove hidden mold to prevent further damage and health issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: A moldy smell suggests hidden mold growth, often in areas with moisture or poor ventilation. Professionals can locate and address the source.
